##### Project general facts

Bali Residences is a modern architectural exemplar poised to become one of the highest quality offerings. This building features a mix of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, making it ideal for both end-users and investors. Combining cutting-edge technology with sleek and elegant aesthetics, the building's unique design incorporates clean lines and bold shapes, creating a striking visual impact that sets it apart from its surroundings.

Experience unparalleled luxury with superior amenities designed to redefine modern living. A meticulously crafted rooftop paddle tennis court offers the thrill of sports and leisure, while an outdoor gym exemplifies dedication to well-being with a unique fitness experience surrounded by nature. Residents also enjoy a fully equipped fitness center, swimming pool, sunken garden, co-working space, landscaped gardens, and a grand entrance lobby. Retail shops, 24/7 security, covered parking, and bicycle parking complete this exceptional offering.

The finishing and materials used in Bali Residences have been carefully selected to ensure a premium living experience. Kitchens and bathrooms feature only high-end fixtures and appliances that offer both style and functionality. The building's facade features large windows that provide ample natural light and stunning views, while the interior is designed to maximize space and functionality. Every detail, from room layout to choice of finishes, reflects a commitment to quality, ensuring residents enjoy a living experience that is truly exceptional.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Triangle, a prime residential community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a unique combination of convenience and luxury. The community is known for its tranquil surroundings, plentiful green spaces, and stunning architecture, creating a peaceful haven in the midst of the bustling city. With a variety of housing options and a well-connected road network, JVT offers easy access to all major destinations in Dubai.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key landmarks and amenities. Dubai Mall, Burj Al Arab, Dubai International Airport, Palm Jumeirah, Mall of the Emirates, and Dubai Marina are all within easy reach. The community is also situated next to Al Khail Road, ensuring residents have everything they need within easy reach, including parks, playgrounds, and essential services.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Triangle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, family-friendly amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
